title: Study to Assess Effectiveness and Safety of Zanubrutinib for Patients With Marginal Zone Lymphoma Treated in Italy Under the Named Patient Program (NPP)
official: An Italian Multicenter Retrospective Observational Study to Assess Effectiveness and Safety of Zanubrutinib for Patients With Marginal Zone Lymphoma Treated in Italy Under the Named Patient Program (NPP)
summary: Observational, non-interventional, retrospective, multicentre study focusing on efficacy and safety of zanubrutinib in daily clinical practice in patients with relapsed/refractory (R/R) marginal zone lymphoma.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Histologically confirmed diagnosis of relapsed/refractory marginal zone lymphoma
2. Patients who received at least one dose of zanubrutinib under the Named patient program (D.M. 7 Sep 2017), between January 2021 and October 2023 3) Age≥18 at start of zanubrutinib therapy. 4) Signature of written informed consent to study participation and personal data processing.

Exclusion Criteria:

1\) relapsed/refractory marginal zone lymphoma patients who received zanubrutinib in a clinical trial context.
